protocol.map_point_definition: 0.2 m world voxel association; each descriptor keeps its source observation world coordinate
protocol.query_center: GT projection of the map point into the different query frame
protocol.visibility: FOV + image mask + black border + z-buffer occlusion at GT pose
protocol.actual_descriptor: historical descriptor from the same map point and camera, source frame != query frame
protocol.shuffled_control: random descriptor from a different map point, same camera, source frame != query frame
